marketRetrieval: Wait until capture.closedAt + 9 minutes, exceeding the frozen eight-minute minimum and covering the last possible five-minute position.
newMinuteFeatures: Rebuild completed minutes from observed positive-volume second bars. Keep context minutes unchanged. Missing minutes remain missing.
quoteAge: Both historical quote and swap timestamps must be at or before observed signal availability and no more than 60 seconds old.
signalMembership: First observed caller/contract is decided on valid-quote eligibility in the fixed context plus this stream, before entry filters or outcomes. All captured versions remain available even if later edited.
